title: AI Extractions Queue
notes: Built list page (/ai/extractions) and detail page (/ai/extractions/[id]) on ListPage/DetailPage archetypes, wired to all 9 endpoints via new desktop/src/lib/api/ai-extractions.ts. detailDrawer is false by design — row click navigates to the full detail page instead (matches the archetype's onRowClick alternative), since this queue needs a dedicated review surface for confirm/reject/create-itinerary/create-invoice/schedule-followup actions. relationCombobox/phoneInput/addressAutocomplete/currencyInput/sendMessageDialog not applicable: no relation, phone, address, currency, or messaging fields in this entity. GET /pending-count is still unused (no sidebar badge wiring) — out of scope since sidebar.tsx badge plumbing lives in a shared hook outside this slice's allowlist.
showcaseScript: Open AI → Extractions and see the pending review queue
Open an extracted enquiry and check the parsed fields
Confirm it and create an itinerary in one click
Show the pending badge count drop
